assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was performed with CPT code 93229
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations
The patient presentation raised concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms were intermittent in nature
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is clinically indicated to capture potential arrhythmic events
The service is consistent with the documented indication for this service
